India reaches Asian Games cricket final, faces Pakistan

The Indian men's cricket team has reached the final of the Asian Games. They defeated Sri Lanka by 124 runs in their semi-final match, which took place on October 1. India will now face Pakistan in the gold medal match. There is a scenario where India could win the gold medal without playing the final match.
